اؤتويت (form VIII)

# اُؤْتُوِيتَ (uʔtuwīta) /uʔ.tu.wiː.ta/: second-person masculine singular past passive of اِئْتَوَى (iʔtawā)
# اُؤْتُوِيتِ (uʔtuwīti) /uʔ.tu.wiː.ti/: second-person feminine singular past passive of اِئْتَوَى (iʔtawā)
# اُؤْتُوِيَتْ (uʔtuwiyat) /uʔ.tu.wi.jat/: third-person feminine s
